# Stackwell Digital

> Web design and managed hosting for local businesses in British Columbia, Canada.

Stackwell Digital builds and manages professional websites for BC local businesses on a flat monthly subscription. No long term contracts. Plans start at $60/mo CAD, or $40/mo CAD to host and manage an existing site.

## Services

- Custom website design and build
- Managed hosting and domain management
- Monthly content updates (included in plan)
- SEO setup and monthly analytics reporting
- Google Business Profile management
- Migration from GoDaddy, Wix, Squarespace
- Free website audit tool at https://stackwell.digital/#audit

## Plans (CAD, month to month)

- Starter: $60/mo. Build, domain, 2 updates per month, hosting, email support
- Growth: $100/mo. Starter plus 6 updates per month, basic SEO, monthly analytics, priority support, semi annual refresh
- Pro: $150/mo. Growth plus unlimited updates, advanced SEO, same day response, Google Business Profile management, workspace email, quarterly check in, seasonal refreshes
- Hosting and Management (existing site): $40/mo. Migration, daily operations, domain management, hosting, SSL, email support
